svg.desc: Mesoscope dff comparison. A/B: mouse 832700, January 30 2026, one session. 1475 High/Intermediate-SNR soma-labelled ROIs in VISp/VISl. 34 clean 90-degree context and 68 matched control trials. A: identical positive-joint and Q2-nonsignificant example ROIs across both versions, VISl_6:64, VISp_1:52; context trial heatmaps and context (green)/control (grey, 50% opacity) means with across-trial SEM. The responsive example additionally requires a peak trial-averaged baseline-subtracted context dF/F >0.5 during [0,0.5) s in native stored units. Its peak is 0.915552. This amplitude gate applies only to panel A, not population classifications. Unresponsive means Q2-nonsignificant, not absence of visual responsiveness. B: context population heatmap in the same frozen context-dF/F Rastermap order for both signals. Population means and across-neuron SEM: solid positive Q1/Q2 responders (225 ROIs), dotted Q2-nonsignificant (1002 ROIs), classified separately per signal. All displayed values subtract each trial's native preceding-grey baseline. Statistical windows use native-frame means, not display interpolation: paired Q1 oddball versus preceding standard over equal 500-ms windows; Q2 Mann-Whitney on context/control response minus full preceding-grey baseline. Exploratory p<0.05 and abs(MI)>0.1; solid means additionally require both MI>0.1. Signed MIs are not clipped. No firing-rate eligibility gate, spike conversion, or Neuropixels smoothing kernel. Linear alignment at approximately 9.48 Hz is display-only. Tan/grey shading shows actual preceding-standard/oddball presentation windows (median trial-aligned bounds, approximately 367 ms), not the 500-ms statistical windows. X-limits remain -0.75 to +0.75 s. Units: ΔF/F change (%); native stored values without additional scaling. Heatmaps blue-negative/red-positive, no colorbar; rounded 99th absolute percentile limits: A ±2, B ±0.4; larger values saturate. These response-selected curves are descriptive; SEM is not across mice. C: 90-degree cohort across 20 sessions in 10 mice. Pool planes within session/area; include groups with at least 20 eligible somatic High/Intermediate-SNR ROIs, before checking testability. Q1/Q2/Both bars include either MI sign and use this signal's own eligible jointly Q1/Q2-testable denominator; n labels are ROI/session observations, not unique longitudinal neurons. Heights are pooled counts, not means of session/mouse percentages. Uncapped lines show exact 95% percentile mouse-cluster bootstrap bounds (10,000 resamples, seed 0): resample whole mice carrying every retained session, then recompute pooled ratios. C has no amplitude gate. VISp: 15719 jointly testable / 15719 eligible ROI/session observations, 20 contributing sessions, 10 mice; Q1 5517, Q2 4066, Both 2633. VISl: 12521 jointly testable / 12521 eligible ROI/session observations, 20 contributing sessions, 10 mice; Q1 4326, Q2 2946, Both 1993.
